verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth is a SaaS authentication service, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI probes are adjacent AI-readability and API artifacts, not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
